text_block_list.text: While talking with Mihono Bourbon whom I met in the hallway, Rice Shower came jogging over.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san,
did you decide on your costume for the party?
I heard from Creek-san the other day—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Status unchanged.
I maintain constant awareness in every situation each day, but have yet to discover a suitable costume target.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I see. But...
you've been thinking about it so, so much for us, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I am unable to find one.
...All I do is run; I am a boring horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
Because, Bourbon-san is...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. Um, if you haven't decided yet,
how about a "Ghost" or something!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A monster... A ghost, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! If it's a ghost, what's inside doesn't matter,
and I think the costume would be easy to make.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is planning to be a vampire,
so you could be a friendly ghost
living in the vampire's mansion, Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even as a ghost,
the interior remains "myself."
Indeed, facial expressions and such will not matter.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Settings recorded. Saved to memory.
Costume has been finalized as
"The Vampire's Friendly Ghost."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Thank goodness...!
Well then, let's go shopping right away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, such cute fabric...
But maybe plain cloth is better for a ghost?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I estimate white is the standard.
However, it is uncertain whether that applies
to this particular costume.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that might be nice... Yeah, let's do that!
Bourbon-san, if we decorate it,
which do you prefer, this flower or the ribbon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see no problem with the design of either.
How about matching the taste of
my vampire friend?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I see! Then Rice has to choose, huh.
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...
Are you okay with the luggage?
Making you carry it for us...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
? Bourbon-san?
Is something wrong...?
Did you get tired, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...No. However, during the shopping trip,
a query has arisen regarding whether I was able
to speak and act appropriately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being shopping for myself,
I could only give mechanical responses.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Eh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san, it's true that... um,
your feelings might not show on your face very much.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But whenever I ask, you always answer, right?
You never lie, and you properly put things into words.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that... Rice didn't have to feel anxious
or worry all alone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was Rice's selfish wish to have you
become a ghost... Bourbon-san took it seriously
and thought so hard about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy... and right now,
my heart is still filled with happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, it's not boring at all.
Bourbon-san makes Rice feel so much fun and joy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even if your expression doesn't change, it doesn't matter.
Rice... loves Bourbon-san just the way you are!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I... feel the same. Furthermore,
"The Vampire's Friend"...
I am looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yeah!
Let's do our best on the costumes...!

A few days later, a ghost and a vampire were spotted
holding hands and laughing together. The gently fluttering
cloth seemed to sway happily.
